title: Glass unit masonry.
officialText:
Hollow glass units shall be partially evacuated and have a minimum average glass face thickness of
3/ inch (4.8 mm). Solid glass-block units shall be provided when required. The surfaces of units intended to be in contact with
16
mortar shall be treated with a polyvinyl butyral coating or latex-based paint. Reclaimed units shall not be used.
